title: Tink to her pity cried a diner’s bell
html_source: With the change of mood, discussing the blind piano tuner, Miss Douce no longer seems to have alacrity. Compare with the lines in the opening ‘With grace of alacrity towards the mirror gilt Cantrell and Cochrane’s she turned herself. With grace she tapped a measure of gold whisky from her crystal keg. Forth from the skirt of his coat Mr Dedalus brought pouch and pipe. Alacrity she served. He blew through the flue two husky fifenotes.’
